features.name: hidden_state
features.rationale: Hidden-state activation from the LLM at the selected layer and pooling. Available at inference time by running the model forward pass.

features.name: max_operand_magnitude
features.rationale: log10 of the largest number in the prompt text. Derivable from reading the prompt.

features.name: prompt_length_norm
features.rationale: Normalized prompt length (chars / 500). Derivable from reading the prompt.

features.name: has_mod_keyword
features.rationale: 1.0 if 'mod' or 'remainder' appears in the prompt. Derivable from reading the prompt.

features.name: has_percentage
features.rationale: 1.0 if '%' appears in the prompt. Derivable from reading the prompt.

features.name: tfidf_features
features.rationale: TF-IDF bag-of-words features from the prompt text. Used only by the TF-IDF baseline.

features.name: subtype_metadata
features.rationale: Task subtype label (A-H). Used only by the subtype-only diagnostic baseline. NOT available at inference time in deployment.

features.name: hidden_norm_stats
features.rationale: Coarse magnitude statistics (L1, L2, mean, std, max, min) of hidden states. Used only by the hidden-norm-only control.

inference_guard.description: The router feature extractor must not access generator internals, latent difficulty parameters, backend assignment rules, or expected preferred backend.
